items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: Brahms, he was an old man, he used to hang around the college they knew Brahms you know?

ctx.x: Yeah that’s very interesting how we have different definitions of old.

Right. They say, “Man that music is old.” I said, “Man that music ain’t old. You think that’s old, what about Shostakovich Tenth Symphony? What about you know a German leider, you know, and Mozart? That’s old. What about Gregorian chant? That’s old. Brahms, he was an old man, he used to hang around the college they knew Brahms you know? Ravel was still alive before World War I you know. So that ain’t old you know and now they call it Earth, Wind & Fire old school you know. They’re the most wanted popular band…
